description: Johnny Austin Thompson is proud to be the unified Democratic candidate for Florida House District 2. A product of our local schools and a lifelong advocate for community health and opportunity, Johnny is running to ensure every family has access to quality healthcare, safe neighborhoods, good jobs, and a clean Gulf Coast. He brings a fresh vision rooted in accountability, service, and a belief that Escambia County deserves a representative working for all of us—not just the well-connected.
title: Updates – Johnny Austin Thompson for Florida House
